subject: RE: Database Migration — Approved
body:
Hi Diana,

I've reviewed the migration plan (docs/database-migration-plan.md) and the associated ticket NEX-189. I'm approving this migration from my side as CTO.

A few conditions:
1. The logical replication standby MUST remain active for a minimum of 72 hours (not 48) post-migration to give us adequate rollback time.
2. Confirm that the on-call engineer is briefed and available for the full 4-hour window.
3. Send a company-wide maintenance notification at least 48 hours before the window.

Priya, please coordinate the on-call rota. Legal has confirmed data residency compliance separately.

Green light for November 3.

Raj Patel
CTO, Nexora Inc.
